treatment.logline: Anudi leaves the shelter of her family car and enters the rain beside a modest food three-wheeler, carrying the belongings that will connect the next scene.

arc.beat: Rain redirects her attention to her occupied hands

treatment.approach: Grounded Sri Lankan everyday drama: ordinary comfort gives way to the practical choreography of rain. Six essential shots supply 24 seconds, with no ornamental coverage. Restrained static frames preserve believable movement and the continuity of her belongings. The acknowledgment is a small visible nod, with no invented dialogue.

treatment.geography: Car stops facing screen right beside the office-side pavement. Anudi exits the pavement-side rear door. Building and food three-wheeler lie along her left-to-right walking route. All roadside coverage stays on the pavement side of the car and walking axis.
treatment.key_image: Anudi walks left to right under her newly opened umbrella, phone still in her right hand, with the small food vehicle behind her.
advice: The rear door is already open at the start of the exit shot; its opening is an ordinary ellipsis, not another staged action.
Show the rear door closing before she moves away.
Keep smartphone in right hand, handbag on left forearm and umbrella in left hand throughout.
Rain begins only in the final moment; overcast illumination stays continuous.
The umbrella opens while she is briefly stationary, then walking resumes in the next shot: H-91 takes precedence over the delivery hint's simultaneous movement.

moments.what: Anudi rides in the rear seat with her attention on her smartphone; the driver remains seated ahead.
moments.cut_uses: A locked pavement-side interior medium single makes her screen attention legible without requiring screen text.

moments.what: The car stops; after an elliptical door opening, Anudi exits with her belongings, closes the door and gives a small nod toward the driver.
moments.cut_uses: A roadside wide supplies the stop, a rear-door medium supplies the exit, and a matched medium supplies the closing and nod. These are consecutive action stages, not duplicate coverage. Her onward movement follows the rain preparation in moment 3.

moments.what: Rain starts as Anudi stands beside the closed car; she opens her umbrella, then walks toward the building past the food three-wheeler.
moments.feeling: Attention moves from the phone to getting through the rain.
moments.cut_uses: A static medium-wide isolates the umbrella opening; a static wide lets her cross past the food vehicle and carries her into the following scene.

editor_notes: The six must takes total 24 seconds for the 23-second reference cut. The 0.5-second handles on the arrival, exit, umbrella and passing shots protect their three-second action windows; use them carefully.

Use the interior single for her phone-absorbed journey; the roadside wide for the car stopping; the paired rear-door mediums for the exit, explicit closure and silent courtesy; the umbrella medium for the weather turn; and the final wide to establish her passing the food vehicle.

Match car position and pavement-side orientation across the stop and exit. The rear door opens in the cut between them, then closes visibly before she walks away. Match the open-door position and Anudi's occupied hands across the two rear-door shots.

Rain begins in the umbrella shot, not before. Match the fully open umbrella, phone in right hand and handbag on left forearm into the final wide. Continue her left-to-right walk into the next scene; do not anticipate the pocket attempt.
The script supplies no exact courtesy line, so use a nod rather than inventing speech. Record or add rain, traffic, latch and umbrella effects in post over the silent-source clips.

Opening the umbrella and walking are consecutive rather than simultaneous: the action-budget default avoids asking Veo to combine the canopy change with travel. The exit and door closure are also separate state changes.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options; none is required by the intended cut. Keep the source shots clean. Avoid mirrors, intricate finger work, a sharply rendered crowd, and unnecessary physical contact.

Anudi's cream blouse, dark trousers and tied-back dark hair and the driver's pale blue shirt are neutral continuity choices; the packet specifies no wardrobe. Maintain their approved facial identity and hair across scenes.
